Who is Chirag Sharma, popularly known as GodofJeets, and why are his controversial remarks sparking outrage across social media?
The US-based Kick streamer has drawn widespread criticism over viral videos featuring caste supremacy, Brahmin superiority and inflammatory remarks about non-Brahmin Indians, including a disturbing reference to a nuclear attack on India.
From his appearance at Clavicular's Camp Looksmax to his controversial statements about caste, genetics, religion and Indian immigration in America, this video examines the controversy surrounding GodofJeets.
